ASHISH KUMAR

Technical skills

Tools and methods spanning field observations, simulation, and spatial analysis.

GIS, Earth observation, and remote sensing

ArcGIS · QGIS · Google Earth Engine
DEM processing, raster/vector analysis, flood-hazard and exposure mapping, and spatial-data analysis.

Hydrologic and hydraulic modelling

MIKE+ 1D–2D · HEC-RAS · ANUGA · HEC-HMS · SWMM · SWAT
Riverine, pluvial, urban, and dam-break flood modelling.

Computation and analysis

ANSYS Fluent · Python · MATLAB · C++ · STATA
3-D CFD, flood–structure interaction, large model-output processing, time-series analysis, uncertainty analysis, economic-impact assessment, and machine learning.

Scientific communication and collaboration

Peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, and oral and poster presentations at EGU and AGU. Interdisciplinary collaboration across hydrology, hydraulics, urban climate, remote sensing, and engineering.
